; The same call, to the same function, after the symbol has been uniqued and
; then cloned. The intrinsic is spelled identically -- stripping a suffix from
; @llvm.memset.p0.i64 would invent an intrinsic that does not exist, and the
; undecorator has a rule against it that this file exercises.
declare i32 @helper.llvm.918273645(i32)
declare void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr, i8, i64, i1)

define i32 @f(ptr %p, i32 %x) {
entry:
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %p, i8 0, i64 32, i1 false)
  %r = call i32 @helper.llvm.918273645(i32 %x)
  ret i32 %r
}
